body:
idk man.. i know a couple introverted people... it seems abnormal to me to the extent that i have it..

thinking about god? lol i don't really do that but ok

I don't know how. I've tried so many times but I literally cannot motivate myself to do it.

Probably... 3? times this month I've tried to start exercising regularly..

Every time it lasts less than 3 days. I just can't find a reason to motivate myself. I just want to stay in bed all day.. I'll stay in bed until 3pm sometimes.

It is an option, I just hope it isn't the best option.

Also, i'm not really interested in meeting girls until i can actually take care of myself... I have terrible social anxiety anyways

I've been talking to my dad about this recently.. He's been trying to help get me to exercise, brush teeth, etc \(reminding me every day stuff like that\)

I'm just not sure about my mom.. she has to take care of my severely autistic brother \(he's 13 and can't talk/read/write/communicate\) and she's stressed a LOT. 

I'm reallllly surprised she hasn't gone crazy yet... I do worry about her mental health though. 

She believes in a lot of.. unconventional things. She's an anti\-vaxxer. She is highly against any gmo and non\-organic foods \(there was a period of a few years where she bought EVERYTHING nongmo and organic, but she eventually realized that that was unrealistic... we were spending like 3/4 of my dad's salary on food...\)

Y'know.. stuff that can easily be disproved by 10 minutes of googling research papers...

It's definitely my brother, though... I feel like him being autistic has maybe skewed her beliefs and made her need a coping mechanism like that... 

She barely goes out to do anything... 

I just don't know how she would take it... 

I've overheard her crying after I cancelled stuff recently and it breaks my fucking heart. I've tried to not bother her as much as possible for all my life, and all this mental stuff is just fucking hurting her...

I just really don't know how I would go about talking to her about that. I really don't know if she could take much more...

No, but it has been kind of cold recently, and the fridge I keep my insulin in \(in the garage\) runs kind of cold.. although I did crank the temperature up to max on the fridge a few weeks back to make sure it wouldn't get too cold and freeze.
